1	/**
2	 * boot.ts — Cloudflare deployment boot sequence.
3	 *
4	 * Registers all Cloudflare-specific service implementations into the shared
5	 * provider registries. Called once on first Worker request (or on every cold
6	 * start — all registrations are idempotent Map.set calls).
7	 *
8	 * This is the only file in `packages/deploy-cloudflare/` that touches the
9	 * server package's registry. Every other file in this package is self-contained.
10	 *
11	 * The import of `provider-registry` uses a workspace-relative path. Wrangler
12	 * (esbuild) resolves it through the workspace symlink at bundle time, so no
13	 * runtime module resolution occurs.
14	 *
15	 * NOTE: `server/src/storage/provider-registry.ts` must be free of Node-only
16	 * imports (it currently is — it only imports types). If that changes, this
17	 * import path will need to move to a standalone `@paperclipai/storage-core`
18	 * package (tracked as an optional follow-up to PR #2).
19	 */
20	
21	import { registerStorageProvider } from "../../../server/src/storage/provider-registry.js";
22	import { R2Provider } from "./storage/r2-provider.js";
23	
24	/**
25	 * Environment bindings required at boot time.
26	 */
27	export interface BootEnv {
28	  /** R2 bucket binding — declared as `PAPERCLIP_STORAGE` in wrangler.toml. */
29	  PAPERCLIP_STORAGE: R2Bucket;
30	  /**
31	   * Logical bucket name stored on object metadata (informational).
32	   * Defaults to `"paperclip-storage"` if absent.
33	   */
34	  STORAGE_R2_BUCKET?: string;
35	  /**
36	   * Optional key prefix applied to every stored object key.
37	   * Useful when sharing a single R2 bucket across multiple environments
38	   * (e.g. `"staging/"` vs `"prod/"`).
39	   */
40	  STORAGE_R2_PREFIX?: string;
41	}
42	
43	/**
44	 * Registers the Cloudflare R2 storage provider with the shared provider
45	 * registry from `server/src/storage/provider-registry.ts`.
46	 *
47	 * After registration, calling `createStorageProviderFromConfig` with
48	 * `config.storageProvider === "r2"` returns an `R2Provider` backed by the
49	 * `PAPERCLIP_STORAGE` R2 bucket binding.
50	 *
51	 * The registry uses a plain `Map`; calling `bootCloudflare` multiple times
52	 * (e.g. on each warm-start invocation) is safe — subsequent calls overwrite
53	 * the previous factory with an equivalent one.
54	 *
55	 * @param env - The Worker environment bindings injected by the CF runtime.
56	 */
57	export function bootCloudflare(env: BootEnv): void {
58	  const bucketName = env.STORAGE_R2_BUCKET ?? "paperclip-storage";
59	  const prefix = env.STORAGE_R2_PREFIX ?? "";
60	
61	  registerStorageProvider("r2", (_config) => {
62	    // R2Provider.getObject returns a Web ReadableStream, not a Node Readable.
63	    // The type cast is intentional — in the CF runtime this is correct.
64	    return new R2Provider(env.PAPERCLIP_STORAGE, { bucket: bucketName, prefix }) as never;
65	  });
66	}
